dials.base: achromatic, black body, near black steps; light: white body, white and pale gray steps
dials.accent: ten pastel accents for identity, neutral primary: a white cell in dark, a black cell in light
dials.depth: flat tone steps, no shadow, no blur
dials.separation: 1px rules: between tiles, around overlays in the bright text color, between dialog actions
dials.radius: 2 on controls, fields and marks, 0 on panels, cards, overlays and rows
dials.controls: bordered transparent cells, a flat white primary, press inverts
dials.type: Inter Variable, small sizes, medium weight labels, tabular figures
dials.motion: hard cuts in steps, 70 to 220ms, no travel, no scale, windows land in four steps
